messages:
incidents-bot: [P0] Routing anomaly detected 1716123456 - sudden spike of errors and latency for tenant acme-corp. Policy mismatch suspected. Auto-paged oncall.

anna (oncall): on it, jumping in. any immediate customer hits?

support-sam: acme-corp reporting 503s and timeouts in their telemetry. a few other beta tenants saw elevated latency but only acme-corp has errors.

matt: I'm taking. quick snapshot: comparing routing logs shows requests tagged policy=dedicated for requests that should match hosted tier. suspect policy rule with model_variant matching got overly broad after yesterday's rollout.

jessie: curious — did the new model tagging PR land in prod? @deploy-bot any deploys around 03:10Z?

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-10T03:09Z "policy-simplify" -> completed on infra/routing-service

matt: that aligns. dump of recent routing evaluation (grep):

```
2026-03-10T03:12:11Z route.eval tenant=acme-corp model_tag=model-x policy=dedicated matched_rule=variant-prefix-match
2026-03-10T03:12:11Z route.action tenant=acme-corp -> dedicated-pool-12
2026-03-10T03:12:11Z forward.failed tenant=acme-corp status=503
```

matt: rule is `variant-prefix-match` which now treats `model-x` and `model-x-fp16` as matching due to simplified matching. we need to narrow it.

anna (oncall): immediate mitigation? can we pin acme-corp to hosted manually or disable the rule globally?

jessie: two options: 1) patch live policy to add exact match for hosted variants (safer) 2) flip priority so hosted rules win for customer pins (fast). I'd go with priority flip then rollback PR.

matt: I'll flip priority for tenant routing table for impacted tenants. executing admin change now.

ops-bot: executing policy update: set route.priority.hosted=200 for tenant=acme-corp

matt: change applied. waiting for propagation... monitoring.

(2m later)

support-sam: acme-corp confirms errors stopped and latency normalizing :tada:

anna (oncall): great. Matt, please open an incident postmortem and include exact diff. Also list other tenants that briefly matched the rule.

matt: will do. quick ad-hoc list: beta-corp, test-tenant-7 saw hits but no errors. I'll collect logs and create INC ticket.

jessie: assigning to eng-routing for root cause. likely revert/patch to matching logic in `policy-simplify` PR and add unit tests.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for infra/routing-service to v2026-03-09-9f2c -> completed

matt: rollback done. will follow up with a canary patch limiting prefix matching and an eval suite.

support-sam: support notified impacted customers and requested temporary credits for acme-corp. keeping customers updated.

anna (oncall): handoff: jessie will lead postmortem, matt owns logs/diff, support-sam owns customer comms. If anything spikes overnight, page oncall again.

jessie: noted. creating postmortem ticket INC-2026-1007 with timeline and mitigation steps. thanks all.

incidents-bot: incident recorded INC-2026-1007. severity=P0. Slack thread archived.
